public_payload.normalized_proposition: LLM technology has only ever lost money and has no path to sustainability.

statement.excerpt: Whether or not LLMs are a useful tool is irrelevant, because the AI industry has demanded the world hand it as much land and money and as many resources as it desires to continue proliferating a technology that has only ever lost money and has no path to sustainability.

from_speaker: a technology that has only ever lost money
our_interpretation: The ordinary financial reading concerns the overall economics of developing and supplying commercial LLM services, including research and deployment costs.
Only ever covers commercial history through the post date. No arbitrary starting date is supplied.
Overall profit is distinct from gross margin, operating profit, cash flow and the profitability of a diversified parent company.

No path to sustainability is read as asserting that no demonstrated, credible self-financing business model existed at publication. Its stronger reading as permanent impossibility is an undated forecast that historical losses cannot establish.
The statement identifies no accounting basis. Under the money-claim rules, that prevents a supported or contradicted financial verdict.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable historical financial records establish overall losses throughout the relevant commercial history, and evidence about operating economics supports the absence of a credible self-financing model at publication. Losses at two developers alone cannot establish the technology-wide assertion.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A commercially relevant LLM business demonstrably earned overall profit under a comparable accounting measure before publication, or had a demonstrated durable self-financing model. Gross or operating profit alone does not establish net profitability.
